dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.enableCodeMiningPreferences>
<!description: Enable specific JDT UI code mining preferences by changing their default boolean value from false to true.>
<!severity: INFO>

$store.setDefault($prefConstant, false) :: matchesAny($prefConstant, "org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.EDITOR_JAVA_CODEMINING_SHOW_REFERENCES", "org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.EDITOR_JAVA_CODEMINING_SHOW_IMPLEMENTATIONS")
=>
$store.setDefault($prefConstant, true)
;;
summary: Change default preference settings for specific JDT UI code mining features from 'false' to 'true'.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
